    BEHIND THE REVIEW

    Two agents. One informed decision.

    This is the proposed product architecture. The walkthrough demonstrates its behaviour with sample data; it doesn’t run AI agents or inspect real files.

    01

    Browser Workflow Agent

    Understands the upload purpose and examines declared destinations and available request metadata.

    Upload purpose + requirements
    02

    Document Privacy Agent

    Selects local extraction, OCR and inspection tools to find supported PII, hidden data and authentication indicators.

    Both agents supply structured findings

    Disclosure Correlation Engine

    Deterministic code joins findings for the same upload session. It is not a third AI agent.

    Combined evidence

    Your Upload Disclosure Report

    You review the evidence, choose supported changes, inspect the verified copy, and separately approve submission.

    Existing foundation The local Aadhaar-masking prototype is already built. This guided demo is a separate concept walkthrough.

    Privacy boundary The proposed product inspects files locally. Only an approved submission shares the file with a recipient.

    Important distinction Declared destinations can be inspected before upload. Actual request destinations are observed during supported upload workflows. Cross-origin does not mean malicious.
